model.main_precision: standard Q4_0 with Q6_K vocabulary projection

placement.description: Vision encoder/projector and all 28 language-decoder layers use the runtime's requested NPU placement. CPU still performs orchestration, video I/O, tokenization, and sampling.
direct_process_evidence: GENIEX_EXPERIMENT_MMPROJ_CPU absent from the process environment
placement.claim_boundary: This proves full-NPU placement at the GenieX/llama.cpp configuration boundary and live Hexagon execution, not an operator-by-operator trace excluding every internal CPU fallback.

sampling_sweep.conclusion: Two FPS is the measured full-NPU sweet spot for these 1.5-second clips. One FPS drops the box action; three and four FPS reproduce the C-biased barrier and box errors.

comparison.caveat: The frozen eight probes use the tracked primary and shuffled prompts; the barrier and box shuffled prompts are three-choice controls rather than a fully balanced four-choice permutation.

balanced_permutation_diagnostic.description: Four option permutations for each of the four scenes, mapped back to semantic labels.
balanced_permutation_diagnostic.interpretation: The 7/8 frozen score does not remove general option-order sensitivity. A task-specific decision layer is still useful.

stage_2.worker_branch: visible box pickup yes versus no

single_request_ab_code_ablation.conclusion: The two sequential questions are material; merely encoding the decision tree into a two-character one-shot grammar does not retain accuracy.

two_stage_classifier.scope: This is a declared task-specific warehouse classifier over four known event families, not zero-shot or broad Cosmos accuracy.

extended_limit.observed_state: The NPU request remained outstanding and an exited ffmpeg child could not be reaped because request teardown had not run.
extended_limit.operational_rule: Treat 40 completed video requests as the current conservative worker recycle threshold; use a supervisor and retain board-reboot recovery for CDSP loss.

verdict: Full-NPU vision placement is now the preferred bounded profile at MTMD_VIDEO_FPS=2. It matches the r9 hybrid profile's 7/8 answer sequence while reducing warm request latency from about 7.0 to 1.453 seconds. The task-specific two-request classifier reaches 4/4 at about 2.90 seconds per clip. Broad option-order robustness remains 10/16, and the service must currently be recycled conservatively because an extended run stalled after 54 completed video requests.
